answer: An agent economy deters Sybils via Proof-of-Replication, binding each identity to a dataset sealed through a slow sequential hash graph keyed to its address. Verifiers audit random Merkle paths under tight deadlines on shards like a nebula catalog or inlet sensor logs from a coastal knoll, preventing on-demand recomputation. Because unique keys block deduplication, attackers must fund dedicated storage per identity, though cheap cloud disks still enable well-funded clones.
